motion_guide.role: Pose/limb ownership study; no guide pixels appear in final art.

additional_generation.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Input1 is an exact eight-frame FOUR-LEGGED WALK MOTION GUIDE; Input2 is the only character-design reference: this beautiful new green-eyed ginger tabby kitten with white chest/chin/socks, detailed orange stripes and a raised ringed tail. Render the character from Input2 into the eight motion poses of Input1. The brown guide silhouette is not the art style: keep the beautiful cat design, fur clusters, green eye and natural cat anatomy from Input2.

Match the guide's paw locations and chronological FOUR-BEAT WALK. The guide colors identify body parts only: GREEN is NEAR HIND leg, CYAN is NEAR FRONT leg, MAGENTA is FAR HIND leg, PURPLE is FAR FRONT leg. Replace all guide colors with cat fur/socks, but keep these four limb identities, hip/shoulder roots, knees/hocks/wrists, planted feet and lifted paw phases. Near legs are bright detailed orange/white, far legs are the same design in shade. The near hind paw MUST reach forward under the belly in frames1/2/3, then extend back in frames4/5/6, then lift and recover forward in7/8. The near front paw lifts and recovers in1/2, reaches forward to land in3, then supports and travels backwards through4/5/6/7/8. Every leg swings at its own phase; this is a walk with supporting paws, not a simultaneous four-foot hop. At least two feet remain planted in every pose. A stable common invisible ground. Gently flex the shoulder/hip/hock joints; no detached or noodle limbs. Draw natural rounded kitten paws with small toes, never flat sticks.

Exact FOUR columns by TWO rows, eight equal square cells and exactly ONE complete kitten in each cell. Reading order chronology. Strict SIDE PROFILE facing RIGHT in all frames, same body length, same eye/head/chest and tail shape. One visible green eye. Body stays centered with only one logical pixel breathing/weight shift; no second-row jump. Tail gently sways from its base, head stays calm. Complete ears, whiskers, nose, tail tip and all4paws in every frame, at least10percent transparent margin on each side of every cell. Do not let any whisker touch a cell border or another frame. Do not crop paws.

TRUE high-quality pixel art intended128x128 logical pixels per frame: deliberate square pixels and clean hard stepped contours, readable hand-grouped fur shading, beautiful clustered stripes. No smooth painting or blur, no jagged red/yellow fringe, no glow or outside-colored dust. Rich tasteful colors with no numerical palette cap. Actual transparent alpha background, no shadows or floor, no guides or skeleton colors, no visible grids, writing, label, border or watermark.
additional_generation.rejection: The generated eight-pose sheet still exchanged/abruptly changed some near-hind leg phases. No pixels from that rejected sheet were adopted in the final native animation.

adopted_pixel_source: Only the newly generated kitten reference supplies the detailed fur, head, torso and original paw pixels. Native Pixelorama separates and articulates the actual limbs, preserves four fur rows at every root, and authors toe, overlap and connected whisker contours.
native_edits: Pixelorama native document.create/add_layer/add_frame/patch_pixels/export_png/export_sheet/save. No abstract geometric leg replacement, no smooth optical-flow frames, no crossfades or duplicate whole-body bob as substitute.
